description.describe_ch:
Calculus is a course provides basic training in mathematics. It involves the differentiation and the integration. These are used to solve problems via geometry and algebra. Calculus has a lot of
applications in many fields, such as science, engineering, economics and management. The materials in Analytic Geometry and Calculus I include the limits of functions, the derivatives, the integrals, the logarithmic  and exponential functions, and the inverse trigonometric functions

gradeRules.evalb_memo: The Final Examination takes 20% of the total grades.
The Midterm Examination takes 20% of the total grades.

The quizzes take 50% of the total grades.
No make-up test for quizzes

The homework takes 10% of the total grades.
Late homework will not be accepted.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Submit homework on time. Do not plagiarize others' work. If you do not understand something, ask your classmates, teaching assistant, or teacher for help.
2. Do not cheat on any exams (including quizzes, midterms, and finals). If you are caught cheating, you will be dealt with according to school regulations.
3. Pay attention in class. Do not sleep, play with your phone, or chat with your classmates.
